summary: What are AWS Local Zones? How are customers using them for hybrid enterprise migration? summary: io2 Block Express is the newest Elastic Block Storage (EBS) volume type designed with the scalability and performance to serve many applications that are traditionally on-premises. In this episode, Simon is joined by Ryan Sayre, Senior Storage Specialist focusing on EBS. They discuss where EBS fits into AWS data storage offerings, and how io2 Block Express delivers on the SAN in the Cloud vision. Learn more about io2 Block Express - https://go.aws/3ohJtZt EBS - https://aws.amazon.com/ebs/ Amazon EBS Features - https://aws.amazon.com/ebs/features/
title: #483: Exploring EBS io2 Block Express

summary: Intelligent Automation on AWS is for anybody who has ever wanted a better, faster way to accomplish a task. It decreases manual effort across an organization and provides 70 to 90% business process efficiency, on average. Listen to the podcast to learn 3 common approaches to implementing intelligent automation, including: AI-powered assessments into how employees actually work; low code and no code point implementations assembled with minimal need for additional code development; and digital workers that can be deployed to provide an automated team member that carries out a specific business process.
